title: Multitasking federation learning method and system based on segmented block chain

pse.problem: Federated Learning (FL) faces challenges like unreliability, single point failure of the aggregation server, and scalability problems due to multi-task concurrency when dealing with large-scale parallel tasks.
pse.solution_function: The system performs decentralized federated learning by dividing the blockchain into a global chain and a local chain, improving the security, computational efficiency, transparency, and reliability of the system.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include blockchain (global and local), Raft consensus algorithm for sharding chain, directed acyclic graph for main chain, and pre-deployed smart contracts in the blockchain.
pse.solution_implementation: Local models are saved and global model is retrieved from the blockchain to prevent potential attacks on the server and reduce single point failure risk. Blockchain sharding balances security and computational efficiency. The system also uses an efficient and low-energy Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus protocol deployed on multiple edge servers for tamper resistance.
pse.effect: The solution improves execution efficiency, scalability, and reliability of the federated learning system.
